name: Filipe Valente
bio: Filipe Valente is a Brazilian filmmaker.

credits.title: The Boom Killer
credits.overview: A great tragedy occurs during the filming of a movie. In an unexpected twist, the renowned Detective Bones takes on the case, as he can sniff out that something isn’t right.

credits.title: The Other
credits.overview: Fernanda is home alone, talking to her best friend on the phone, when an unexpected visit interrupts the night. Standing before her is her own clone.
